description: This file defines a custom exception class `CustomerServiceException` within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends the base Exception class and adds a static method to generate a specific exception message related to customer deletion constraints.

classes.name: CustomerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically for customer-related service errors.
